review:
Everything
Nothing
Vanni was available whenever we needed and responded quickly.  The place was clean and had everything we needed. The location was excellent.  Less than 10 minutes from the center.

Antonio is a wonderful host. He met us at the airport and even waited for 2 hours as we sorted out a lost suitcase. The apartment is really nice, and comes well stocked with coffee, breakfast items. Great location too!

Really good location, has a great breakfast. Room was large and comfortable.
The bathroom was very tight and small.  shower was in a bathtub and leaked on the floor when used.

Honestly, this place spoiled us for anything else. The attention to detail, fabulous decor, just an amazing renovation all in all. Loved the high ceilings and original floors. Big beds, super comfortable accommodations, and everything we needed. Simone and Ignazio were so kind and helpful, we loved them too. Great value for money, plus good location in Sciacca. We would highly recommend Domus Aleria for an extended stay while exploring nearby, as well as trying out the excellent restaurants in Sciacca.
We were on the third floor and there is no lift but Simone helped with our bags on the way in and the way out. It was not a problem for us but other travellers should be aware.

Great location and very clean. Owners are wonderful and kind
The stairs, lots of stairs. Very steep and hard to navigate with luggage. Only young people can navigate the stairs.

Good price / value , Friendly staff, good italien breakfast,
Location is perfect for the cave (2min walk) but not in the town so really quiet , could be more decorated a bit , everything was working good and was clean but feel a bit like a hospital room  without any decoration .  Overall really good value I recommend if you want to travel on a budget .

The host was extremely kind and helpful. The apartment is located in the city center, with easy access to the monuments and stores. Great customer service and facility. The apartment is very beautiful and unique
Cleaning

We enjoyed the freshly baked cornettos not to mention the hot drink options.  Christina was exceptionally  accommodating and made us really feel at  home!
Nothing that I could think of

The location was amazing!
The key collection can improve,i have to take the keys from Santa Margherita! Also the flat inside..the furniture is old,there is no slippers,the shower curtain is dirty,over all the money for night worth it only for the view and the location.also you have to throw your garbage by urself ,in case you forgot you will be charge with 50 euro.

All services is up to the standard and more.
No More options in the breakfast menu (scrambled eggs only) though in general the level is acceptable.

The property owner was an exceptionally helpful and friendly individual. It is rare to be met with so much advice and help! We especially appreciated the thoughtful details like beach towels and ice box - the things we didn't have with us and it made a huge difference to have them available for us.
We arrived late in the evening and all the free parking around the place was taken. As 3 women we didn't feel safe to look for a parking lot far away. That was the only inconvenience we experienced. Next morning we parked right at the house when people left for work and space became available.

The location was nice. It was far enough away from the bustling of crowded tourist spots, but close enough for us to hop on a scooter to get to said spots in a matter of minutes. There was a taxi lane in front of the hotel, so it was easy for us to unload and load when we checked in and checked out. 
The room was quiet enough at night. Sound travels very easily with the windows open, but we weren't bothered. The beds were quite comfortable, and the space was ok but inconvenient (especially when it comes to luggage). A/C worked just fine, and not sure about the TV since it stayed off for our entire stay. 
Front desk staff were friendly and were able to answer our questions and re-stock our room when requested.
Checking-in was a hassle. The power in the building was off, and the WhatsApp chat (which we were told to join to ask questions) was non-responsive (for the whole trip actually). The Monti is on the 3rd floor, and we had about 100lbs of luggage (each) that we were carrying. We received no messaging on the booking.com app about this power disruption, so upon arrival we were flustered and in fact thought were scammed on this booking. After walking up 6 flights of stairs (2 flights per level), and using my phone light I was able to reach the front desk. As they were frustrated, so were we. I had to ask for help with luggage (no one was actively assisting people checking in); for some reason I definitely felt like this was a reasonable expectation. They had no estimation as to when the power was going to be back on, and asked us to join the WhatsApp chat for updates. After leaving the hotel for dinner, checking the chat--there were no updates to our requests. No biggie, since the power was on when we came back to the room. It was just an annoyance to be given the assurance of the responsiveness of the chat--and not hearing back. 
As for the room--we had 2 check-in and 2 carry-on bags with us (along with 2 backpacks), so there had to be some repositioning every time something had to be pulled out of our luggage. There was definite closet space, but not conducive to opening and closing our luggage. I had to open my luggage one at a time on my bed, whereas my friend had to open her luggage on the floor in the walkway. Just an annoyance.
The WiFi was definitely below par. The reliability was intermittent, and would often be kicked off on our devices.
Accommodation, restaurant and breakfast
The location was excellent. Right on the subway and so many cafes, bars, restaurants. Extremely convenient location. Gianguido and the staff were all lovely and helpful. Enjoyed my stay.
It was extremely noisy and 2 workers walked into our room unannounced so we felt scared our stay. The bathroom had mold and there were bugs.

Breakfast was excellent. Good selection and good coffee. Room was nice and comfortable.
All good.

Location is amazing, right next to Roma Termini, Staff was really genuine and offers you a program plan without even asking (no benefit for them behind it) Mathieu and Slim were extremely helpful, cheerful and nice… im definitely coming back to this hotel again.
Almost nothing, maybe the fact that rooms are not fully soundproof, but this wont affect my good experience.
Close to all important sites to visit, perfect.
Very clean, very friendly. Amazing spot for tourists looking to see the sites of Rome easily by foot.

The property was in a good location. It has a lot of potential to be good. It is not.
The property was not clean. The dishes and cutlery were not clean. Washing detergent, and basic cleaning utensils, and rubbish bags were not provided. Half a role of toilet paper was provided only. There were several power cuts due to overloaded electrical circuits. The floor was dirty and in need of a good clean.  The dishes”shared” patio was not shared, and in fact could only be accessed through a room.

Good location, space comfortable
Showers was small. No lights at entry, motion lights would be useful to prevent falls on the stairs after dusk.

Everything was great and very professional. The property is a 10-15 minute walk from the train station which was perfect for us as we took daily trips to different cities. The property had everything that we needed and communication with the owner was always fast and clear.
The bed pillows were a bit too firm for my liking but I still slept fine.

We loved the hosts and their service. They were very nice people who accommodated all our needs.
Not many grocery stores around, or we didn't know about them. We were with our granddaughter, and she is a picky eater.

We loved our stay at la Casa di Tamy. The apartment was super well equipped, with everything we needed for our extended stay. Located just outside the gates of San Gimignano, it is quiet but within steps of the centre. We particularly appreciated the large refrigerator, dish washer, washing machine, and beautiful views! Our host was incredibly responsive and accessible.
Honestly, we loved it. The living, dining and kitchen spaces are all combined, leaving room for only one comfy chair in the living area...but as long as you're not wanting to spend time watching TV (why would you when there is so many other things to do!) it's not a problem.

The location was central and good for walking Sorrento.  This room would be good for an overnight stay.
The room was a little small and good for an overnight stay.  It seems the apartment is divided with several rooms.  We were not greeted but hosts and usually are at all the places we stay.  But the check in went smoothly and nice gesture of having water in the fridge and limoncello shots.  It was comfortable and safe building.

Communication with the host was great, and it turned out even better when we connected with the host's mom, who was absolutely fantastic. The place itself was nice with no complaints, and the fully stocked kitchen was a definite plus. We also appreciated the good Wi-Fi and cleanliness. A huge thank you to the host for being so accommodating and letting us temporarily store our luggage during the cleaning process before the next guests arrived; that helped us immensely!
Expect some street noise at night from partygoers

excellent location with a great view. Enjoyed the terasse.
the bathroom floor was wet.

Interior space is nice, very clean, and spacious.
Nothing stood out as such.

Sooooo well located, really comfy too
nothing

Wow.  The apartment sits high above Agrigento, with stunning views of the Valley of the Temples and the sea beyond,  Free secure parking is provided and the apartment easily accommodated 3 adults.  The host was helpful and welcoming.  The apartment was modern, clean and nicely furnished.  The second bedroom was up a small flight of stairs.   We declined the offer of nearby dinner reservations and instead chose to purchase food at a local store and enjoyed dinner on the outdoor patio overlooking the city.  
We did find the bed very uncomfortable.  It felt like a single box spring without a mattress.  This does not detract from our high opinion of the apartment.
The basic breakfast was again enjoyed on the stunning view.
We highly recommend La casa di Pippo Flora if you are visiting the Valley of the Temples.
The bed was too hard for our liking.

The estate is beautiful, comfortable and nice decor.
i didn't really loved the chalet style rooms, where you share a big space wit other rooms.. also not very good noise blocking. You could hear everything that was happening in the next room.
the food at the restaurant could have been better

Great location in the city center, yet quiet. Warm and functional atmosphere. Very close to the underground parking. Just a few meters from great restaurant and stores. Attentive and nice host.
It was all good, maybe I would just suggest putting a privacy film on the small window in the washroom.

The location was excellent, and the staff was accommodating.
The room was dated, and air conditioning didn't function.

Excellent location, with a great place to stay within reataurants, markets, beach and train nearby.  Great response from owners on any question marks you could have.
Nothing

Pool was exactly what I needed.
Food was inedible and awful. Went to the Marriott to have my dinner which was just down the road. That dinner was amazing.

The room was comfortable and the hotel was very close to a lot of restaurants and attractions.
There were not a lot of amenities - they only change the singular towel every two days for example - no food, nothing like that. It isn't a very fancy place but I feel like they could have stepped it up a little bit.

Great location.  Our host Mariangela took care of us. She was very helpful and made sure we were comfortable while staying in the B&B. Breakfast was good. The apartment is part of the historical building, but has been renovated.  Great soundproofing,  we had a good night sleep.

We stayed at the Rome Charming Suites in Rome for three nights. I enjoyed the authentic traditional aesthethic of the decor and it was quite clean. The host was very kind and accommodating. It's about a 30-40 minutes walk from the colloseum, but only minutes away from the metro. I also enjoyed the garden area. Overall, I would recommend this hotel for a stay in Rome.

The house was big and comfortable. The host was welcoming and helpful with information. It was in a convenient location, not far from parking lots to visit the town center. We were given a map with many helpful suggestions.
The kitchen was not convenient. It did not have a toaster or other basic kitchen supplies. There was this big machine in the kitchen that I assumed was once a vending machine, that only took up place. Many plates were chipped, and everything was piled one on top of the other with the pot lids hidden in the oven. If that machine were removed and an addition counter-storage space put, the kitchen could be organized to be more functional. The only complaint, which I did not notice before booking, was that there is no washing machine. We were travelling with 2 young children (3 and 1) and that was a very inconvenient! We have to go to a self serve laundry, while the kids napped. We stayed at 3 other places during our 3 week vacation, and this was the only one without.

Perfect property and location. Wonderfull location with fantastic restaurants all walking distance from the agriturismo
the walk up the hill to view the basilica was a little daunting. However, it was well worth the walk.
The host was super friendly, my husband and I had a great time there. We enjoyed our stay and loved the location.

clean and renovated
wifi was weak
Close to train/bus station. Clean bathroom and spacious bedroom, powerful AC. Luggage storage.

Excellent service, rooms were clean and comfortable and amazing location by the ocean and walking distance  to shops and restaurants🥰

All good!

Location

The apartment is in a stunningly beautiful location and was clean, spacious and comfortable.  The host was lovely and made our stay very comfortable.
Everything was great.

All of the staff were friendly.  It was clean. The breakfast was included and good.  30 minutes from the centre of town.  Lots of food options, pharmacy, and supermarkets around. Had a mini fridge

The shower is tiny and every moment makes the doors open.  I did extend my stay got the double room and it was great.  Window, bigger shower, more open so would recommend a double.

The view was beautiful
Walking distance to markets and restaurants.
A little hike up a hill to get there but that was part of the fun!!
Caterina was a wonderful host, with quick response and very very helpful with any questions we had.
Would definitely return.

A very nice place overall.

Looks so solid and the fixtures etc are tip notch. The walls seemed to amplify the rooms next to me... I have never experienced that before...

It's an easy 10-12 minute walk to the Trevi Fountain and about 30 minutes to the Colosseum. What truly sets this place apart is the exceptional host, who proactively reached out via WhatsApp to ensure our comfort and support throughout our Euro trip. We'd definitely stay here again!

I have to mention the exceptional hospitality of our host Cindy. We were in a really challenging situation and Cindy went beyond "above and beyond" to help us out. Thank you so much for all your help, Cindy 🙏🏽.
The apartment itself was fantastic, well located, good sized rooms, good bathrooms and kitchen. All items were provided: sheets, pillows, kitchen appliances, etc.

I would highly recommend this place to anybody.

Beautiful grounds. Spacious rooms. Wonderful staff/owners. We had a wonderful meal at their restaurant. They went above and beyond.

The rooms are delightfully appointed and comfortable with views of the marina and Ortigia just beyond.  As it is just outside the main tourist areas, it is very quiet at night.  The rooms have pleasant balconies with seating. There is a pleasant breakfast area and lounge shared by guests.  There are restaurants close by and Ortigia is only about 8 minutes walking distance.

very little to like.it met basic needs to stay in Venice for 3 days. Beds were restful.
The front door could use proper closing instead of a chain that wraps around the door knob and with a manual lock.
pungent odour in prime bedroom coming from washroom...also kitchen area had foul odour not mention the flood that occurred during a torrential rain fall. furniture in living room area looked a little tired. wifi password was a puzzle to read.
Lastly the remotes for the TV needed batteries, nowhere to be found. ....

The room was located close to the train station and within walking distance to everything we wanted to see.
The staff (Oliver) was a fantastic host, very welcoming and helpful.
There was a neighbourhood power outage, and the response by Oliver went above and beyond what we would expect at pretty much anyplace else. Thanks, Oliver!  
If we are in Rome again we will def stay there!

They have really good amenties and the room is amazing. The check in and check out is has been really smooth. I would recomment it 100%. Would go back here in a heartbeat.

The room was amazing and even had a rooftop terrase accessible directly from a stair located in the room. It had a small fridge and all the equipment required. The bed was very comfortable and the hotel was located at a decent 15 minutes walk from the old part of the city.
There is no parking onsite, the closest available option was at about 800meters which is not that bad if you plan to stay for a couple of nights. The fridge was not that cold and so was the AC. Besides that it was awesome.

Excellent decor. Clean and comfortable.
No breakfast. No water in the room.

Decent for short stay, walkable in the Fiumicino area.  Place was clean and tidy, and breakfast was provided.
Although it was close to the airport, it was still a 10 min drive, and costed 30 euros by taxi to get there. Did not have any hand soap, messaged property manager but no response. Early checkout (10am), and was not able to accommodate a later checkout even for 11am.

Lovely restaurant for breakfast. Buffet with lots of choices of cold items both sweet and savoury. Great cappuccino. Modern decor with glass staircase and elevator. Very clean. Comfortable bed, nice view of the piazza from our window. Good location about 10 minute walk to train station but close to restaurants.
Room on the small side and no place to hang clothes.

Felt like we were in a movie! Or on a ship! Those views!! The Terme, pool and Spa are lovely. The staff, especially Rosanna, were very welcoming and helpful.
The lighting in the lobby, bar and restaurant was full on LED. Could be greatly improved by changing it to more atmospheric lighting.

We had no idea what to expect of the area, but loved it. Close to larger centres, but close to vineyards and many historic sites. The accommodation was excellent. Breakfasts, excellent. We will recommend to friends.
We liked it all. No complaints. Staff was very helpful and if we were out about, places were easy to find.
The property was easy to locate as Loris gave detailed directions from the train station. The property was well located with a clean & comfortable room.

The shower box was clogged ( old problem, considering the raised level of the vinyl floor in the washroom and the spots of water on the door. Almost the entire room was invaded by the water within a couple of minutes. Just one of us was able to shower, and our luggage and its contents were soaked.
The solution was to dry the copious amount of water with a rag and offer to change the room. Of course, they knew we were about to check out. Offer made just for the sake of.
See above

It was clean, the host was nice, helped us with any information and was punctual with communication.
The air conditioning was not working and it was very hot in the room. There was an old and moldy smell in the room.

Small family business,  the entire family works on the premises and is doing their best to keep it running as smoothly as possible.
Location of lower apartments just a couple meters from the beach.

Plus, after that unfortunate wait in excruciating heat we got a shuttle shared with another couple buy we were still charged full price of Eur70 as we would get an individual transfer.
Also communication problem caused unpleasant payment related issue at check-out. Luckily it was finally solved.

Great location. Very clean. Host is very helpfull.
Although it’s ok, air conditioning is not the best when it’s very hot outside.

Before we came, our main worry is, without reception desk, how convenient to reach the property manager when in site. The quick response in messaging before we got to Rome released our worry. The surprising smoothness of our check-in amazed us. The comfortableness of the newly renovated room surprised us as well. The location is super good, in a safe area with nice residences around, near bus stops and city center. There is even a nice super market in the same building.
Great breakfast, Great staff. The view was amazing. The pool was very good and was deep. I hope to go back and stay here again in the future. The parking was very good and very easy.
Location was perfect, in the heart of Rome. The person at the reception was very helpful and nice.

The perfect base from which to explore Cinque Terre. 

The location is incredible. Located right at the start of the path to Carniglia. The views from the room are absolutely stunning. 

The room was comfortable, clean, and spacious. The balcony overlooking Vernazza and the water are the cherry on the cake. 

Communication with the host was smooth and easy. Check-in was a breeze. We even received a little video showing us how to find the room from the train station. 

100% recommended for your trip to Cinque Terre. Staying in Vernazza means you get to enjoy the most beautiful town after the tourists have left. :)

Buffet was excellent
U would have liked a beach with sand. However, it’s on the rocks. Thats how puglia is.

The Breakfast was extravagant with lots of variety, fresh fruits, variety of fresh croisants, breads, yogurts, meats and cheese.  You could order your eggs fresh in 3 ways, with bacon.  Coffees were also individually made, all in an elegant Belle Epoque decor, with chandeliers and mirrors and lots of windows looking out over the ferry landing.  The welcoming Concierge was cheerful and happy to help with my luggage going up a cobblestone Hill in a separate building.  My room was brand new renovated with gorgeous views of the Lake Como Harbor.  Wine, bottled water and Prosecco was in a small fridge.  The Staff at the Hotel was very welcoming and warm-hearted.  I loved my Stay of 3 nights at this Hotel in Varenna.  Make sure you book the restaurant for evening meals well in advance as it’s wonderful.
Nice. Very calm. Nice to jump in the pool after a day in Siena

The location was very central to be able to walk in town. The room was clean.
If you are travelling by car, there is no easy way to park, unload/load. Also parking can be many blocks away, and while not expensive, it still is an added expense. 
Booking.com website said the rooms have a view. Not ours! Cement walls to look at. The site also said breakfast included, but didn’t expand to say it was yogurt and milk in the fridge with crackers and cookies in packets. Not at all what we were expecting. 
The neighborhood has renovations happening which just adds to the stress of car maneuvers!

Very nice apartment. Clean, comfortable, and well equipped. Sandra is an outstanding host. She greeted us in person, provided lots of info and great suggestions for activities and transportation. 
I definitely recommend it.
Minor detail, but an upgrade in towels and pillows would be nice.
Beautiful unique building, amazing amenities,  wonderful meals. Staff were very friendly and helpful.

Host was friendly and welcoming. Room was fresh and modern, it looks like it was recently renovated, which made it feel even nicer. Stylish bathroom. Thick window blinds. Breakfast was tasty with great coffee, they even provided gluten-free options. Location was also very convenient.
Room was very small, beds could have been bigger and more comfortable

We were so glad to have found this hotel — the view was incredible, the bed very comfortable, everything spotless, and the breakfast just perfect. The highlight of our stay was Cristiana, our host, who took such great care of us. Thank you!

This farmstead is a true gem; I feel very fortunate to have experienced it. It offers a unique stay that surpasses many five-star hotels. The location is ideal—just 20 minutes from the airport in a peaceful rural area—making it a perfect base for exploring the southern coast of Sardinia. The room was exceptionally clean and tranquil, enhanced by the natural aroma of wood, a very comfortable bed, and quiet air-conditioning that ensures restful sleep.

The hosts are welcoming, helpful, and highly knowledgeable. I recommend asking Marko for suggestions on local activities and attractions. Additionally, be sure to participate in the olive oil tour to learn about the production process firsthand.

The breakfast was outstanding—healthy, homemade, delicious, and offering a wide variety of options. I look forward to returning and reconnecting with my new friends in Sardinia. Thank you for a memorable and enjoyable experience.

Very spacious, clean, contains amenities, and convenient location

The owner was very helpful and made the stay a great experience. The accommodation was perfect for our family. Walking distance to shops, beach and  restaurants.
Sitting in the third floor and accessible via the stairs  is to mention.
The staff were very friendly and helpful. Window had ocean view.

This is our 2nd time back we love this hotel ! Rooms are so big lots space. Views are fabulous.  The breakfast is great. The people who run the hotel treat us like friends are visiting. ♥️
No comment we ❤️ this hotel.

close the doors

sufficient

Athena was a great host she explained everything super well, absolutely lovely, would recommend to everyone plus close to the Vatican.

The large room

This hotel was fantastic, from the quaint setting, the excellent breakfast, and the perfect amenities - I would race back here to stay longer!
If you want to be in town, know that it isn't - but there's a bus stop out front, free transit, parking, and a cute pathway down to town!
Great location

It was wonderful to have the breakfast included. Our rooms were not ready when we first arrived but it didn’t take long and they allowed us to sit and wait in the lobby until they were ready . The staff at the front desk were pleasant and helpful. They called cabs for us it was easy to walk nearby and find a restaurant.

Excellent service, communication and location. Please was also really nice. 
I would definitely return.

location was amazing and host was incredibly helpful
the furniture is very tired and AC in the master bedroom doesn't work well. More towels and a few facecloths would have been useful.  It was great having a washer!

Position of the unit  and communication with the owner, very nice and helpful!
Small room
Mr Ron is very helpful and acommodating
Great location in Portoscuso near restaurants by foot. Mixed room and Angela and her husband were great hosts...very helpful and friendly.
Very good breakfast!
Everything exceeded my expectations, a short team from downtown

The location was amazing!
All the stairs were not clearly disclosed, I knew there was one flight to get into the apartment and a flight of stairs to get to the loft sleeping area, but there is still a steep wooden set and a spiral staircase to get into the apartment. If you have large suitcases it is not very fun getting them up the stairs! The stairs are very steep and in my opinion a bit sketchy.
The shower was sooooo small that we could barely fit through the opening! 
The sofa bed would not be comfortable for more than one person as one of the sides is incredibly hard and uncomfortable.

Nice and clean room with balcony with great view. Rooms are quiet and kind owner
I don’t appreciate when as guests, we need to ask for water in the rooms and pay for it. This should be included in the (not so cheap) total price we pay and even more so that we are in the middle of June in Ischia and it’s extremely hot… 

 I was also not offered any breakfast, only dry toast crackers and a sealed cube of butter and a coffee. I booked this place thinking breakfast would be included but that was not what I thought it would be based on the description… also no AC in room

We picked it because it was close to the airport and provided a shuttle bus.
It was expensive and should have included breakfast and free shuttle.

The location was good for our purpose. We wanted a place, where kids would sleep in a separate room (it was a bunkbed for them) and with free parking.
The garden view room doesn't have any view and also there were lots of mosquitos outside and inside the room. The room has provided fumigator tablets, they helped, but just a little.

The location was great and the host was easy to reach. She was very kind to let us leave our baggage on the premises before check in.
The washroom was dated with lots of mildew. The towels all had a strong smell of vinegar. It is very noisy as you can hear folks talking in the next rooms. The rooms itself was dated and just clean enough. The cost was rather high for what you get, as we have stayed in cleaner, more modern, quieter accommodations in the same area for much less.

Friendly and attentive host. Clean and spacious apartment and great location.
Nothing

Newly refurbished
Brand new facilities
Very neat and clean
Location

We had a nice stay at Hotel Montreal. The location is excellent—right next to the train station and just a short walk to the city center. Our room was bright, clean, with a working AC and enough space for our needs. The 24-hour reception was a plus, and we appreciated having an elevator to reach our floor.

Great view, close to town, quiet, nice hosts, very clean.

My mother and I visited Venice and stayed at Ca’ Cappellis from June 9th to 15th, 2025, to celebrate her 77th birthday. We stayed in the King Suite on the 2nd floor—52 stairs up (there is no elevator). Thankfully, the host kindly helped my mother with her suitcase, which was greatly appreciated.
The building had a charming Venetian feel with a grand door and security cameras. As two women traveling alone, we felt very safe in the area—and throughout Venice.
The suite was amazing—very large with 20-foot ceilings, beautiful decor, and a spacious, modern bathroom with a walk-in shower. The bed was very comfortable, and the whole space felt clean and luxurious. It was extremely hot, so the air conditioning was a lifesaver. There was a TV (we didn’t use it) and a window with a charming street view.
The bathroom was well-stocked with slippers, toothbrushes, toothpaste, vanity kits, shampoo, and soap. There was also a bidet—though we didn’t use it. Two bottles of water were in the fridge, along with a coffee and tea station.
There’s a shared lounge area, though we didn’t use it.
Before arrival, we received a helpful WhatsApp message from the host with buzzer code info, where to find the key, and directions from the airport—right down to the boat line and company to take. This made navigating much easier.
The host was extremely friendly, suggested a nearby place for dinner on our first night, and helped us get our bearings using a map the next day. That small gesture really helped us feel more confident exploring the city.
The beginning of our stay felt like royal treatment. Ca’ Cappellis is in a fantastic location. We absolutely loved our time in Venice and will definitely return!
There are a few areas where improvements could elevate the guest experience to exceptional.
1. Two rolls of toilet paper were provided on the first day, and they were never replenished—we ended up having to buy our own.
2. The tissue box was already more than half used and wasn’t replaced.
3. Coffee pods and tea were supplied initially, but by end week we were down to one pod and three tea bags.
4. The two cookies offered on the first day were never replaced, nor were the two bottles of water in the fridge.
(Not sure if they were meant to be replaced but would have been nice)
5. We paid for the breakfast cart (appx $30 Cdn/day). It started off beautifully—full, fresh, and made us feel like royalty. But by midweek, it noticeably declined. Bottled water was only included the first two days. I requested apple juice and received it once, but then all juice disappeared. Two cereals became one. By the last day, we were disappointed as we paid extra for this service.
6. Guest soap was never replaced. On the last day, three mini shampoo bottles were added—but all had broken seals and were half used.
7.  One of the bathroom sink had a leaking faucet and the sink drained slowly. I wrapped a towel around it so I didn't use it as water would leak onto the toilet paper and down on the floor. I did bring this issue up to the host and she said she would have a plumber look at it.
8. This is just a suggestion - maybe add a logo notepad or logo paper in the welcome folder. We needed paper and hadn’t thought to bring any. The host did provide us with a pen to use, which was very helpful.
9. The host was present every day—except checkout day. We weren’t given instructions on check out, so we just left the keys in the door. Hopefully that was the right thing to do.
I think these issues can be resolved by making sure the staff stay consistent and restock everything in the rooms.
*Overall we had an an amazing experience, these things would have made our stay exceptional.*
